result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. Nothing is committed.

- **HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now match `(html|htm|xhtml)` instead of `(html|html|xhtml)`. This is the `.htm` typo fix; the three rules are the only ones that changed.
- **.NET XML docs:** `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` is checked for the `<doc>` line.
- **JavaScript:** `.*/[.]js` became `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` is checked for the `// Generated by` line.
- **Gradle:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` is in the build-and-deployment scope.

The content patterns are unchanged, so ordinary `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files without the marker lines stay out of those scopes. Path patterns are matched against the whole path, so the existing matches still hold: `.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle` and `.js`/`.xml` files with the markers all still match.

`mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test` completed with no failure output. No existing test covers these conventions, and I did not add one. I also did not run the new patterns against sample files; the match behaviour above comes from reading the regex code.
